title: A batch gate waiting for a slot pauses no new work
description: Every host heavy-job slot is held and the real batch gate waits for one: the loop cycle still launches a free worker on the ready item, master status shows the gate's waiting line beside the claimed item, and the gate takes the next slot that frees and verifies main (GY-3518).

steps.name: a waiting gate leaves implementation launches running and status shows both
